events.name: Claudio Simonetti's Goblin
events.info: Friday, October 30 Claudio Simonettis Goblin plays Dario Argentos TENEBRAEat Cinematheque at Cleveland Institute of ArtDoors 7 PM | Show 8 PMALL AGES$50 advance / $55 day of showFully seated event. No assigned seating, first come first served. Composer Claudio Simonetti has written and recorded some of the most influential scores and soundtracks in horror, including Suspiria, Dawn of the Dead, Deep Red / Profondo Rosso, Demons, and many others, with his seminal work still informing the genre to this day. This year, Simonettis Goblin celebrates Dario Argentos 1982 critically acclaimed classic, Tenebre, with a live performance of the score set to a screening of the film. Following the finale of the movie, the collective will return after a brief intermission to deliver an additional performance of quintessential Goblin material and best of songs and scores set to their cinematic counterparts.

events.name: New Long Road - California Dreamin': A 1966 Folk-Rock Show
events.info: New Long RoadCalifornia Dreamin: A 1966 Folk-Rock Show by New Long RoadNew Long Road is a unique Cleveland-based band, a folk-rock-jazz-classical group, consisting of five music-business veterans combining their talents: David Budin (vocals and guitar), Celia Hollander Lewis (vocals, Celtic harp, 12-string guitar, autoharp and banjo), Robin Stratton (vocals and ukulele), Jeffrey Singler (cello) and Sara Lambert (flute). The group performs songs youve never heard, including originals, and songs you havent heard in a long time all in ways youve never heard them done with David Budin providing humor and music history between songs. And for this performance, California Dreamin: A 1966 Folk-Rock Show by New Long Road, theyll perform their distinctive versions of some of the greatest songs of the original folk-rock era, along with the often-surprising behind-the-scenes stores of the songs and artists who wrote and recorded them. New Long Road members have performed onstage with, or opened for, an array of world-famous performers David, Robin and Celia with artists including Linda Ronstadt, Graham Nash, Peter Yarrow, Jeff Beck, Jefferson Starship, Poco, Flying Burrito Brothers, Jimi Hendrix, and others. And Jeffrey and Sara play or have played with the Youngstown Symphony, Warren Philharmonic, Ashland Symphony, Columbus Symphony, Erie Philharmonic, Akron Symphony, West Virginia Symphony, Cleveland Chamber Collective, Lake Effect Piano Trio, Obsidian String Quartet, Prism Jazz ensemble, and the Erie Waters flute ensemble.

events.name: Jurassic Quest – Cleveland, OH | Huntington Convention Center
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!  

Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.  

🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.  

🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.  

❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.  

Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.  

🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨
